title: Write Claude default settings over the workspace user's at each start
author: anton-matosov
body:
## Summary

Claude default settings (worktrees from a fresh `main`, auto mode, Opus, the denied tools, no auto memory, …) now reach every Coder workspace. Baking them into `/home/dev` would not: home is a volume, filled from the image only once (ADR 0012).

```text
agent-services.target starts
  claude-default-settings   copy the image's defaults over ~/.claude/settings.json
                            (writes through a dotfiles symlink, keeps the link)
  claude-pre-approval       adds enableAllProjectMcpServers when trust is on
  claude-remote-control     starts with both in place
```

Defaults win over anything the user changed in `~/.claude/settings.json`, at every start. Deliberately simple while there are no users; merging under the user's own values can come later.

Also carries `fresh` worktree baseRef for this repository's own Claude settings.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the coder-template smoke test asserted that with both Claude pre-approval choices off no `~/.claude/settings.json` exists.
  **After:** it asserts the file is exactly the Claude default settings in a fresh home, and that a symlinked file's target holds the defaults plus the pre-approval key, still a link. `coder-template smoke test passed`; hadolint and shellcheck clean.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** workspaces

A workspace user's own edits to `~/.claude/settings.json` are overwritten on their next workspace start.
